next_step_summary: PR #312 performs a second-pass audit of Concept Lexicon v0.2 against Foundation Core, Mechanism Map v0.2, the recurring Question Engine inventory, Expert Pack examples/playbook, and the current sanitized/printed mechanism packets. v0.3 corrects semantic kinds: LETTING_ENTITLEMENT_CLAIM and CONDITION_ACKNOWLEDGMENT are ASSERTIONs; LEASE_TERM is a TEMPORAL_STRUCTURE; DEFECTS_LIST, PROPERTY_INVENTORY and CONDITION_PROTOCOL are DOCUMENTs rather than links; DISPUTE_FORUM is a contractual RELATION whose legal/procedural effect remains external. TRANSFER_RESTRICTION moves from M05 to M06. Seven explicit concepts are added for previously underrepresented distinctions: CONTRACT_DEFINITION, USE_OCCUPANCY_RULE, LANDLORD_TRANSFER_RULE, LEFT_BEHIND_PROPERTY_RULE, SERVICE_ACCOUNT_REGISTRATION, EVIDENCE_PRODUCTION_OBLIGATION and EXTERNAL_FINANCIAL_FRAMEWORK. The compact teaching set now contains 54 top-level concepts plus 10 reusable temporal roles, while preserving all 30 historical concept IDs. This remains documentation/research only: no Router schema, extraction schema, Gold labels, runtime rules, statutory authority, provider use or privacy boundary changes. Next, evaluate fresh concealed synthetic clauses in a separate model context, count omissions/excess routes and test linked-clause retrieval without sending real contracts to an external provider. Direct RC PDF identity and canonical TF_C linkage remain UNKNOWN.
